resources.string: Add a scale, and every weigh-in lands in Health Connect.
Step on the scale so it lights up, then tap Find. Android lists the scales it hears and asks whether OpenWatch may use the one you pick.
OpenWatch needs this to hear the scale.
Not known yet. Step on the scale once.
Android is not waking OpenWatch for this scale, so weigh-ins are heard only while the app is open.
OpenWatch saves each weigh-in from a Bluetooth scale as it happens, with the app open or closed. It never connects to the scale, and nothing is sent to the internet.
The scale encrypts what it sends. Pair it once in Xiaomi Home, read its Bluetooth key from your Xiaomi account with a token extractor tool, and paste the key here. It stays on this phone.
A key is 32 characters: digits and the letters a to f.
This key does not open what the scale sends. A scale paired again in Xiaomi Home gets a new key.
Weigh-ins are saved while OpenWatch is open.
Android did not find the scale. Step on it to wake it, then try again.
OpenWatch needs the Nearby devices permission to hear the scale.
On this version of Android, hearing the scale needs the location permission.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on to hear the scale.
This phone cannot listen for the scale.
Only the weight arrived. Body composition needs bare feet and the phone close by.
Body fat, lean mass and body water are estimates from published equations. They differ from what the scale shows.
Set your height and sex in Body profile to get body fat, lean mass and body water.
Some weigh-ins are waiting to be saved to Health Connect.
OpenWatch is not allowed to write everything the scale measures to Health Connect.
A weigh-in the scale assigned to someone else was not saved.
Its weight, heart rate and body composition are removed from Health Connect.
OpenWatch stops listening and forgets the key. Weigh-ins already saved stay.
